intended_use: Catalogue of external forecasts that the project may score on the frozen protocol windows W1/W2 (protocols/evaluation_protocol_v5.json). The registry stores metadata only: no forecast value, no series, no vintage value and no reconstructed number appears here. A source is scored only when an adapter exists, the licence register allows use and a local data path is registered; everything else is reported as NOT_FETCHED, UNAVAILABLE or RESTRICTED, never as a number.

rules.no_raw_values: this file carries provenance metadata only; a forecast value, vintage value, quantile or event probability must never be written here (tools/external_scorecard_v2.py rejects value-like keys and numeric series)
rules.no_network: the tool that validates this registry does not download anything and makes no network calls
rules.licence_first: the licence status is recorded before any data acquisition; RESTRICTED and UNVERIFIED entries are never read, even when a local copy exists
rules.status_precedence: when several conditions apply, the stricter status wins: RESTRICTED (licence) > UNAVAILABLE (no mappable target/horizon or no archive) > NOT_FETCHED (usable licence, no local data) > ADAPTER_READY (adapter + licence + local data path)
rules.mapping_rule: EXACT means the published quantity is the protocol quantity on the protocol grid; PENDING means a documented transformation would have to be registered before scoring (it changes the target, so it is a protocol decision, not a registry edit); NONE means no protocol target or horizon matches
rules.change_rule: a new source is added with status NOT_FETCHED and adapter_state PLANNED; it becomes ADAPTER_READY only after the adapter, the licence register entry and a local data path all exist and the tests cover the adapter

statuses.ADAPTER_READY: an adapter is implemented, the licence allows use and a local data path is registered: the source can be scored on the protocol windows now
statuses.UNAVAILABLE: a non-licence blocker prevents scoring: the public archive is not in the repository, or the published quantity has no protocol target/horizon mapping (status_reason names the blocker)
statuses.RESTRICTED: the terms of use do not allow scoring or republication (subscription, members-only, news terms, or an unverified licence); values are never read
statuses.NOT_FETCHED: the licence allows use and the mapping is EXACT or PENDING, but no data has been retrieved into the project yet; nothing here is cited as observed

licence_statuses.OPEN: public terms allow research use (attribution may still be required in the derived report)
licence_statuses.OPEN_ATTRIBUTION: public terms allow research use with mandatory attribution and no logo/endorsement use
licence_statuses.RESTRICTED: subscription, members-only, news-redistribution or otherwise incompatible terms
licence_statuses.UNVERIFIED: no dated verification of the terms exists; treated as RESTRICTED and never read

targets.RECESSION: protocol T3_RECESSION: NBER recession month inside (t, t+h], horizons 3/6/12 months
targets.UNRATE: no protocol target in v5: sources that forecast unemployment are catalogued, but they cannot be scored until a target is registered (a protocol change, not a registry edit)

horizon.native: current quarter and the next four quarters

publication.cadence: quarterly survey with an official news release in the middle month of the survey quarter
publication.vintage_policy: the release date of the survey quarter fixes availability; the local file is the latest revision of the medians, not a point-in-time snapshot, and errata after the release are not audited
publication.publication_date_source: src/amfe/ensemble/spf_calendar.py (official SPF news-release dates; never the response deadline)

licence.note: research use; the register condition keeps the median values outside git and out of every published artefact, so only errors, counts and dates are published

sources.notes: the only source scored by the current scorecard (T2 h=0/h=1, 233 PIT points); its values are read from the git-ignored file and never published

horizon.native: one-year and ten-year ahead CPI inflation expectations (INFCPI1YR/INFCPI10YR in the local file)

publication.cadence: same quarterly SPF release as the GDP medians
publication.vintage_policy: release date fixes availability; latest revision in the local file

licence.note: same register entry and the same values-outside-git condition as the GDP medians

sources.notes: the local file already carries two CPI expectation codes, but they are 1-year and 10-year expectations, not the protocol y/y CPI at t-1+h: treating them as T1 would silently change the target, so no adapter exists

horizon.native: probability of a decline in real GDP in the next quarter (the Anxious Index)

publication.cadence: published with each quarterly SPF release
publication.vintage_policy: release date fixes availability; the published probability is a survey aggregate, not a vintage series

licence.note: same register entry as the other SPF products

sources.notes: the event is a decline in real GDP, while T3 is an NBER recession month in (t, t+h]: the definitions differ, so the Brier score would measure a different event (docs/174 section 6)

horizon.native: quarterly average unemployment rate for the current and next four quarters

publication.cadence: published with each quarterly SPF release
publication.vintage_policy: release date fixes availability; latest revision in the published tables

licence.note: same register entry as the other SPF products

sources.notes: protocol v5 has no unemployment target (T1 CPI, T2 GDP, T3 recession), so the source is catalogued but unscorable until a target is registered

sources.notes: the adapter and its strict schema exist and are covered by tests, but the archive is not in the repository; the current scorecard reports UNAVAILABLE/ARCHIVE_NOT_LOCAL and the registry repeats that, it does not claim coverage
